templates.name: أفعال plural template
templates.signature: an added opening element, then the radicals with a long low vowel before the last

templates.name: أفعلة plural template
templates.signature: the same opening element with a closing taa marbuta

templates.name: فعول plural template
templates.signature: a long back vowel between the second and third radical

templates.name: فعال plural template
templates.signature: a long low vowel between the second and third radical

templates.name: فعال homograph (singular noun / third-form masdar of the same skeleton)
templates.signature: letter-identical to the فعال plural row; only the vowels and the entry separate them

templates.name: مفاعل extreme-plural template
templates.signature: an added opening mim with a long low vowel after the first radical

templates.name: فعلاء plural template
templates.signature: the three radicals closed by a long low vowel and a hamza

templates.name: فُعُول plural skeleton == singular فَعُول (declared collision)
فُعَلاء plural skeleton == singular فَعْلاء (declared collision)

weak_realizations.licensing_note: DELIBERATELY MINIMAL. No realization of a weak radical is licensed for any template in this increment: no committed fixture in this pack evidences a licensed substitution or a licensed literal weak realization, so every weak radical of a matched template abstains (weak_declaration_unbound or weak_realization_unlicensed). Widening this table is a linguistic decision for the ṣarf authority (adp-sarf-nahw-authority), made in DATA — no consumer edit is required to license a further realization.

rich_hover_fields.teaching: names the matched plural template and whether it reads as paucity, multitude or an extreme plural

reminds the reader that agreement is chosen from the referent, not from the plural's shape
